verdict.rationale: Extend documents a public REST API with Bearer-token authentication, API reference endpoints such as file upload, an API quickstart, official SDKs in four languages, sync and async modes on every processing endpoint, and test-mode API keys. Together these clearly let a user drive the product programmatically. The community item mentioning API cost is a pricing complaint and does not bear on whether the API exists. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of using the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Extend API authenticates every request with a Bearer token. Create an API key from your Developer settings
Upload and create a new file in Extend. This endpoint accepts file contents and registers them as a File in Extend, which can be used for running workflows
Extend provides official SDKs in Python, TypeScript, Java, and Go to help you integrate faster and with better type safety.
Every processing endpoint in Extend (extract, classify, split, parse, and edit) supports both a synchronous and asynchronous mode.
The Extract API accepts a `config` object that controls how documents are processed and how values are returned.
